title: AsyncAPI npm Supply-Chain Compromise & Miasma RAT

steps.title: Abuse privileged pull_request_target workflow
steps.text: The attacker abuses a misconfigured, privileged GitHub Actions `pull_request_target` workflow to obtain secrets from an untrusted fork PR.
steps.description: The attacker abuses a misconfigured, privileged GitHub Actions `pull_request_target` workflow to obtain secrets from an untrusted fork PR.

steps.title: Steal maintainer PAT and push malicious commits
steps.text: Using the stolen PAT, the attacker pushes malicious commits to the next branch and triggers trusted publishing.
steps.description: Using the stolen PAT, the attacker pushes malicious commits to the next branch and triggers trusted publishing.

steps.title: Publish trojanized @asyncapi/* packages
steps.text: Trojanized package versions are published to the public npm registry.
steps.description: Trojanized package versions are published to the public npm registry.

steps.title: Code execution on module import
steps.text: On install/import, `sync.js` spawns a detached Node process that fetches second-stage payloads.
steps.description: On install/import, `sync.js` spawns a detached Node process that fetches second-stage payloads.

steps.title: Deploy Miasma RAT and harvest credentials
steps.text: The Miasma RAT is deployed, harvesting environment variables, tokens and cloud credentials.
steps.description: The Miasma RAT is deployed, harvesting environment variables, tokens and cloud credentials.

steps.title: Establish persistence
steps.text: The RAT establishes persistence via systemd services, cron/scheduled tasks or registry run keys.
steps.description: The RAT establishes persistence via systemd services, cron/scheduled tasks or registry run keys.

steps.title: Decentralized C2 and lateral discovery
steps.text: C2 is conducted over IPFS / Nostr relays / BitTorrent DHT while the RAT performs remote-system discovery.
steps.description: C2 is conducted over IPFS / Nostr relays / BitTorrent DHT while the RAT performs remote-system discovery.

steps.title: Detect trojanized package execution
steps.text: Blue team detects post-install script execution spawning detached Node processes and connections to known C2 infrastructure.
steps.description: Blue team detects post-install script execution spawning detached Node processes and connections to known C2 infrastructure.

steps.title: Contain and remediate supply-chain compromise
steps.text: SOC quarantines runners/endpoints, removes affected versions, revokes credentials and rebuilds from verified commits.
steps.description: SOC quarantines runners/endpoints, removes affected versions, revokes credentials and rebuilds from verified commits.
